verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Semgrep publishes an llms.txt at docs.semgrep.dev/llms.txt (HTTP 200). It is a structured index linking to Markdown versions of doc pages (e.g. index.md), and many docs pages are served as .md URLs, giving agents clean, agent-oriented documentation to consume. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents using the llms.txt, evidence of an expanded full-text variant (e.g. llms-full.txt)

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
